resize_sample_with_aspect_ratio: create a Resize transform that resamples an image sample to a target width and height while keeping aspect ratio
normalize_image_with_mean_std: create a NormalizeImage transform that normalizes a sample image by subtracting mean and dividing by std
prepare_sample_for_network_input: create a PrepareForNet transform that transposes and casts a sample image to float32 for network input
apply_min_size_to_sample: create a function call to apply_min_size that upscales a sample dict to at least the given minimum size
constrain_dimension_to_multiple_of: create a Resize transform and call constrain_to_multiple_of to snap a dimension value to the nearest multiple
